name: laplacelib
comment: The library dialect shares every pattern with `source.laplace` -- same expressions, `library { }` block, `pkg::func` calls, comments, literals and types. It differs only in what it does not require: a `.laplacelib` file may be bare function definitions with no `functions { }` wrapper and no model-shaped blocks at all. None of the shared patterns are scoped to an enclosing block, so nothing has to be relaxed here; the separate scope name exists so themes and future semantic-token work can target the two dialects independently.
